preparation.query_partition: all 56 rows frozen as external queries; no query labels used as context
preparation.composition_policy: Reported wt%; Fe = 100 minus reported non-Fe elements because Fe is explicitly balance. Unreported elements/dashes stay NaN; explicit Nb zeros remain zero.
preparation.electrolyte_policy: Nominal mol/L from cited double-concentration recipe; sum all chloride salts. Bicarbonate not mapped to carbonate. No pH-derived hydroxide.
preparation.procedure_policy: Numeric CP_time, Prep_time and Prep_redox left NaN because shared registry units are unverified; original seconds/volts retained in row_audit. Aeration/agitation unreported.
preparation.target_policy: Workbook mV vs SCE retained without conversion; separate scoring file; no re-estimation from curves.
preparation.metadata_policy: Alloy identifiers and sorted replicate rank excluded from predictors. No row aggregation; 56 replicate targets but seven distinct inputs.
limitations: Nb-induced microstructure absent from feature schema

protocol.query_partition: all 56 external rows; identical for every model and checkpoint
protocol.context_partition: all 4,787 original EPIT/Soccol rows; no Zhang or MPEA labels
protocol.preprocessing_partition: fit on context only, using each model's original native/fixed-schema settings
protocol.interpretation: Checkpoint trajectories are diagnostics, not external-label model selection; 56 repeats represent seven feature vectors.
